label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
**Subject:** Order TH-48217 never arrived: resend or refund needed by Friday 13 November

Hi there,

I'm writing about order TH-48217, which I placed on 21 October and paid R1,640 for by card, including R95 delivery. This is my third email about it, and I'd really appreciate a reply from an actual person this time, not the template.

The tracking says the parcel was delivered on Tuesday 3 November at 11:42 and signed for by "M. Adams". It wasn't delivered to us. There is nobody called Adams at Bergview Pre-Primary in Plumstead. Our gate guard, Uncle Faizel, writes every delivery down in a book, and there is nothing in it for the 3rd. I've also checked the delivery address on the order and it was correct.

I emailed on 4 November and again on 6 November, and both times got the identical reply: "we have escalated your query to our courier partner". I phoned on Friday, sat on hold for 38 minutes, and was told nothing can be done until the courier finishes its investigation, which could take 10 working days.

I'm sorry, but I can't accept that. I bought from Tiny Hands, not from the courier. I didn't choose them and I have no contract with them. You do. Whatever went wrong on their side is something for you to sort out with them, and I shouldn't have to wait for the outcome before I get what I paid for.

To be honest, I'm upset about this. I paid for this order out of my own pocket, on a teacher's salary, for a class of other people's children. R1,640 is a lot of money for me to be out of with nothing to show for it. My kids made their mask patterns last week and I've been telling them for a week that the paint is "coming soon". Our end of year concert is on 27 November and I need these supplies to make the props.

I need one of two things by Friday 13 November:

1. The full order resent so that it reaches the school in good time before the concert. That's 6 tubs of finger paint, 4 bags of playdough, 200 paper plates, the googly eyes, the glitter glue and 2 rolls of brown paper.

2. A full refund of R1,640, including the delivery fee, back to my card.

I don't mind which, but I do need it confirmed in writing by Friday, by someone who has read this email. Another "we've escalated your query" isn't an answer.

I've ordered from you three times before with no problems, which is why I came back and why this has been so disappointing. I'd honestly prefer to sort it out with you directly. But if I haven't had a proper answer by Friday, I'll ask my bank to do a chargeback on the payment and I'll leave a review about how this was handled. I'd rather not do either.

I can send a photo of the delivery book page for 3 November if that helps. You can reach me on this email or on [your cell number].

Thanks,
[Your name]
Bergview Pre-Primary, Plumstead

Add your name and number before sending, and delete the offer of the delivery book photo if you can't get one.
